description: Source code for TimedTextSRTSource class, which handles parsing and providing subtitle data in SRT format within the Android media framework.

classes.name: TimedTextSRTSource
classes.description: Handles parsing and serving SRT subtitle data from a data source.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes subtitle parsing by scanning the file.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Resets internal state and stops subtitle processing.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves subtitle text and timing information, appending descriptions to a parcel.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Reads through the entire subtitle file to build an internal vector of subtitle info.

methods.name: getNextSubtitleInfo
methods.description: Parses the next subtitle block from the file, extracting timing and text.

methods.name: readNextLine
methods.description: Reads a single line from the data source, handling different line endings.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves subtitle text for a given timestamp, supporting seeking.

methods.name: extractAndAppendLocalDescriptions
methods.description: Converts subtitle text into parcel descriptions with specific flags.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns metadata describing the subtitle format.
